title: Characterizing Linguistic Attributes for Automatic Classification of Intent Based Racist/Radicalized Posts on Tumblr Micro-Blogging Website
reasoning: The paper focuses on identifying racist and radicalized intent in social media posts, specifically categorizing content into 'Religion' and 'Race'. It evaluates and classifies posts related to religious topics (such as Islam and Jihad) to differentiate between hateful speech and non-racist religious discourse, thereby involving a significant component of evaluating religious content and extremist ethics.
